title: aleogr project declaration, version 1
description: The file .aleogr/project.json. The topic aleogr-<name> is derived, not typed: the list sent to GitHub is that topic plus repo.topics, sorted, without duplicates, so repo.topics must not contain aleogr-<name> (this rule is not expressed in the schema).

name.description: Project name: 1 to 14 characters of a-z, 0-9 and -, starting with a letter, not ending with -; not test, not shared, not starting with test-. With environments, at least 3 characters: the CI identity's account id <name>-ci needs 6.

owner.description: 1 to 39 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and -, not starting or ending with -.

name.description: Repository name: 1 to 100 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, ., _ and -; not . or ..

description.description: 1 to 350 characters, without double quote, backtick, $, backslash, curly double quotes (open, close, low) or line break.

topics.description: Extra topics only. The topic aleogr-<name> is derived and must not be listed here.

components.description: The project's components (written sorted by name). Each name and each path is unique in the list (this rule is not expressed in the schema).

name.description: Component name: 1 to 20 characters of a-z, 0-9 and -, starting with a letter; not changes or ci (jobs of the project's CI file), nor true, false, null, yes, no, on or off (YAML does not read them as names).

path.description: The component's folder, relative to the repository root: one or more parts separated by /, with no empty part. Each part uses only a-z, 0-9, -, _ and .; is not . or ..; does not start with - or . (so never .github, .aleogr or under them); does not end with a dot. No two components have the same path, and no component's path is inside another's (web and web/api cannot both be components; these two rules are not expressed in the schema).

version.description: The language version, major.minor. With the stack go it is 1.22 or later, comparing the major and then the minor as numbers (1.21 and 1.9 are refused): the Go starting point's routes need Go 1.22. The pattern checks the form only; the minimum is stated in prose.

cloud.description: Where the project's environments run. Valid without environments, where it asks for nothing in the cloud.

region.description: A GCP region name, such as us-central1.

root.description: Only tst: the project tests the tooling and its cloud projects are created inside the folder tst. A real project has no root.

environments.description: The project's environments. Only dev is built yet, and its value is an empty object. A declaration with environments has cloud, and a name of at least 3 characters.
